description_en: Modifies a site monitoring task by calling the ModifySiteMonitor operation
description_zh: 调用ModifySiteMonitor接口修改站点监控任务
name: ModifySiteMonitor

parameters.help_en: The URL or IP address of the monitoring task
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en: The ID of the monitoring task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the monitoring task. The name must be 4 to 100 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh: 监控任务名称。长度4~100个字符，取值可包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和汉字
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The monitoring frequency. Valid values: 1, 5, and 15. Unit: minutes. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 监控频率。取值：1、5、15。单位：分钟。默认值：1
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The detection point information. The value is in JSONArray format, for example: `[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`, where `city` corresponds to Beijing, Hangzhou, and Qingdao respectively.

You can call the DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList operation to query detection point information. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115045.html. If this parameter is left empty, the system randomly selects three detection points
parameters.help_zh:
探针信息。格式为JSONArray，例如：`[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`，`city`分别对应北京、杭州和青岛。

您可以通过DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList接口获取探测点信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115045.html。如果该参数取值为空，则系统随机选择3个探测点
parameters.name: isp_cities

parameters.help_en: The advanced extended options for the protocol type of the monitoring task. Different protocol types correspond to different extended options
parameters.help_zh: 监控任务对应协议类型的高级扩展选项。不同监控任务的协议类型对应不同的扩展选项
parameters.name: options_json

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule. The ID of an existing alert rule in CloudMonitor. You can call the DescribeMetricRuleList operation to query alert rule IDs. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则ID。云监控中已存在的报警规则ID，可通过DescribeMetricRuleList接口查询，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.name: alert_ids

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the monitoring metrics.

Unit: milliseconds (ms)
parameters.help_zh:
监控指标的单位。

单位：毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: interval_unit

parameters.help_en: The custom monitoring schedule. You can select a specific time period from Monday to Sunday for monitoring
parameters.help_zh: 自定义探测周期。只能选择周一至周日的某个时间段进行探测
parameters.name: custom_schedule

Code.description_en:
The status code.

The value 200 indicates success

Data.description_en: The details of the node task result

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
